projects.name: v2.0.0 Stabilization
projects.description: Complete v2.0.0 framework: docs suite, skills, validation scripts, lifecycle commands. Active plans feed here until all activations in MASTERPLAN.md §3 are cleared.

projects.name: Federation Protocol
projects.description: End-to-end federation exchange — sync direction rules, trust levels, conflict resolution. Tests span framework ↔ instances.

projects.name: Non-Tech Onboarding
projects.description: Web wizard + GitHub Actions backend so non-technical operators can bootstrap an instance without CLI. Scoping stage.

projects.name: Instance Orchestration
projects.description: Track and orchestrate all downstream instances. Drift monitoring, cross-instance skill/package catalogs, promotion pipeline. New as of self-hosting inauguration.

projects.name: Skill Promotion
projects.description: Promote skills validated across ≥2 instances to framework-canonical status. Current candidates: research (in refi-bcn-os + refi-dao-os), DAO-module skills (in dao-os).

projects.name: Package Integration
projects.description: Treat packages as a first-class framework concern, parallel to skills. Audit packages/, define lifecycle (promotion + retirement), and resolve the consumption mechanism (how instances activate framework packages). First end-to-end test: promoting the dashboard package.

projects.name: System Reliability
projects.description: Make reliability a first-class concern. Four failure modes (data integrity, agent runtime, federation drift, recovery) × four trigger layers (manual, pre-commit, CI, scheduled). Audit existing checks, decide the layering, implement enforcement. End state: every failure mode has ≥1 enforced trigger; recovery is a documented runbook.

projects.name: Instance Bootstrap Pipeline
projects.description: End-to-end pipeline for creating a new org-os instance: framework cloning, wizard with package/skill selection, and knowledge bootstrap with one source ingested as proof-of-pipeline. The engine; non-tech-onboarding becomes the web UI wrapper on top.

projects.name: OPAL Rollout
projects.description: Roll production-ready OPAL integration (integrations/opal/) out to operational instances (refi-bcn-os, refi-dao-os) so meeting transcripts populate data/meetings.yaml automatically.

projects.name: Operator Interfaces
projects.description: How non-agent humans work with org-os day-to-day. Primary surface: Obsidian (the vault is already an Obsidian workspace). Secondary: Obsidian Canvas for system overview + live operation. Candidate packages: packages/obsidian-interface, packages/obsidian-canvas.

projects.name: Framework Evolution
projects.description: Longer-horizon: new instance specs (regen-coordination-os, regen-toolkit), support for new org types (Fund, Initiative, Coalition), federation at scale (10+ nodes).

projects.name: rad-org-os
projects.description: The sovereign distribution: full org-os stack on Radicle, plus the missing org layer for Radicle (which has no org/team primitive). Public artifacts shipped 2026-07-31 (docs/RAD-ORG-OS.md, /modules/rad-org-os, roadmap). Next: substrate driver interface, Radicle bootstrap path, seed-node runbook, KMS radicle connector. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-31-rad-org-os-artifacts-design.md
